name: Kickserv
description: Jobs, the schedule, estimates, invoices, messages, and payments for a small home-service company. HVAC, plumbing, cleaning, pest. Around since 2003. Later bought by ReachLocal. The date and the price of that sale are not on the record.

mentions.evidence: GetLatka shows $2.2 million a year in May 2022, up 189 percent from $761,700 in April 2021, with the source not recorded. 1,400 customers and 17 employees in May 2022. $600,000 raised in one round that month. The site, read 11 November 2026, prices plans at $60, $119, and $199 a month for 5, 10, and 20 people. Those prices are the menu, not the 2022 revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: A small field tool, then a sale to whoever already sells marketing to those shops. The price of this sale is unknown.

whyItPrints: A two-van shop pays a small monthly plan so the day is not a paper notebook.
